rule: When Russian PKI support is active, Good Bear owns one native public contextual identity with the exact managed purpose. Only its non-default userContextId may become a future scope-authority snapshot. Deletion recreates a new identity and invalidates the old ID; duplicate/corrupt purpose state returns no ID. The manager never identifies or authorizes a container by its name, color, icon, window, or preference.
follow_up_boundary: M5-02 owns the feature enable/disable preference and lifecycle policy. M5-03 through M5-05 own assignments, routing, tab/session continuity, and private-browsing policy. M6 owns first-navigation safety. This task creates no origin assignment and grants no Russian PKI trust.
